question.zh: 从工程师转向技术教育者(devrel、全职内容创作者)要注意什么?受众从哪里来?
question.en: What should you watch for when moving from engineering to technical education (devrel, full-time content creator)? Where does an audience come from?

text.zh: 他的路径是工程师 → 兼做 devrel → 全职教育者。给想积累受众的人的建议很简单:选一个社区,服务它;AI 时代「够好」的内容人人都能做,策展和判断力才是关键。
text.en: His path was engineer, then part-time devrel, then full-time educator. To build an audience, pick a community and serve it. AI makes good-enough content easy to produce. Curation and judgement matter more.

title.en: Pick one community and go deep

how.zh: 与其什么都讲,不如专注一个社区或一个工具,持续解决那里的人的问题。他自己就是从 XState 社区、再到 TypeScript 社区走过来的。
how.en: Rather than covering everything, focus on one community or tool and keep solving its people's problems. He came up this way himself, from the XState community to the TypeScript community.

title.zh: 从兼职 devrel 起步,别一上来做孤军 devrel
title.en: Start as part-time devrel, not a lone devrel

how.zh: 他先在公司内做「一半工程、一半布道」的角色;他也认同「第一份 devrel 工作不要是团队里唯一的 devrel」,因为没有护栏,很容易倦怠。
how.en: He first had a half-engineering, half-advocacy role at a company. He also agrees that a first devrel job should not be as the only devrel on the team: without guardrails, burnout comes easily.

anchors.quote: I'll be splitting my time 50/50 between engineering and advocacy
anchors.quote_zh: 我会把时间五五分给工程和布道

anchors.quote: There are no guard rails on devrel - extremely easy to burn out.
anchors.quote_zh: devrel 没有护栏,极容易倦怠。

title.en: Go full time once there is a product direction

how.zh: 他离开公司全职投入课程,并和专门做课程平台的团队合作,自己专注内容。
how.en: He left his company to work on courses full time, partnering with a team that specialises in course platforms while he focused on content.

anchors.quote: My first day as a full-time content creator is next Wednesday.
anchors.quote_zh: 我作为全职内容创作者的第一天是下周三。

anchors.quote: I've partnered with an amazing team.
anchors.quote_zh: 我和一支很棒的团队合作。

title.zh: AI 时代靠策展和判断
title.en: In the AI era, rely on curation and judgement

how.zh: 「够好」的内容会变得廉价,教育者的价值在于挑选、组织和判断什么值得学。2026 年他还把自建的个人知识库当作业务的基础设施,用来充实课程。
how.en: "Good enough" content becomes cheap; an educator's value is in choosing, organising and judging what is worth learning. In 2026 he also treats his own personal knowledge base as infrastructure for the business, feeding the courses.

anchors.quote: _curation_ is going to be the make-or-break skillset of the content creator.
anchors.quote_zh: 策展将成为内容创作者成败的关键技能。

anchors.quote: my personal wiki has become critical infrastructure for my business.
anchors.quote_zh: 我的个人 wiki 已经成为我业务的关键基础设施。

text.zh: 把第一份 devrel 工作做成「独自一人」:没有护栏,容易倦怠。
text.en: Taking a first devrel job as the only one: no guardrails, easy burnout.

text.zh: 只做「够好」的内容——AI 时代这类内容会被大量替代。
text.en: Making only "good enough" content, which AI will replace at scale.

stance.zh: Stately:工程转 devrel(五五分);加入 Vercel 做 devrel;年底成为全职内容创作者。
stance.en: Stately: from engineering to devrel (a fifty-fifty split); joins Vercel as devrel; full-time content creator by the end of the year.

stance.zh: 与课程平台团队合作;认为策展是关键;建议「选一个社区,服务它」。
stance.en: Partners with a course platform team; sees curation as the key; advises picking a community and serving it.

stance.zh: 选题跟随受众需求(暂缓 Effect 课,先做 AI + TS);用个人 wiki 和 agent 支撑业务。
stance.en: Topics follow what the audience needs (the Effect course waits, AI plus TS comes first); a personal wiki and agents support the business.
